caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cross composed of two brown planks intersecting at right angles. The cross has a loop at the top, suggesting it is meant to be hung. The surface of both the vertical and horizontal beams is adorned with several yellowish-brown leaf-like shapes, spaced unevenly across the wood. There are visible grain lines and some small markings on the wood, giving it a textured appearance. The background is an off-white color with no additional objects or decorative elements. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the sheet.
title: Cross
